jobs.Duty:
About the Role
As a leading Chinese cobot export manufacturer, the EMEA region is one of the important regions for Dobot. The EMEA sales team is expanding and we are looking for team members who will help shape the future of Dobot business success in EMEA. The key function of this role is to create demand and achieve high win rate on repeat sales through sales development and application consulting work. This role covers the Nordics market.

Responsibilities:
- Achieve sales targets and YoY growth via project-driven channel partner network.
- Identify cobot application opportunities at end users.
- Develop, maintain, and foster relationships with end users and partners.
- Coordinate end user visits, make presentations, demonstrate products, support and share application insights.
- Achieve high repeat sales by ensuring first time end users or key accounts have successful deployments and satisfactory experience with Dobot/ partners.
- Handle all end users’ enquiries/ leads.
- Co-create lead generation strategy with Regional Head and Marketing.
- Carry out events to educate the market on cobot applications and generate leads.
- Gather market intelligence and support with sales forecasting and other reporting materials.
- Record and maintain all info. from customer meetings, leads, opportunities, activities etc.
- Coordinate and participate at bigger events (i.e. conferences, exhibitions).
jobs.Require:
- Min. 5 years of experience in establishing, developing and managing channel partner network.
- Preferably from the automation or robotic industries.
- Ability to operate between “hunting” for new possibilities and “farming” existing customers and finding the required channel of partners to develop the business.
- Strong understanding of solution sales business and working with channel partners.
- Adanced-level English skills required.
- Willingness to travel as needed (40-60% of the time).

jobs.Duty:
1- According to performance requirements, explore potential customers, reserve high-quality customer resources, achieve the sales target of responsible market and ensure steady growth of business in whole EMEA region.
2- Responsible for the develop and maintenance of key account customers in local markets, establish a stable and excellent relationship increase chances of business , achieve the goal of a certain number of notable customers.
3- Collect market feedback and users 'advice, investigate the market and competitive product information to put forward constructive suggestions for product optimization and development, help us to develop more reasonable product and market strategies.
4- Building up good relationship to customer and connect them frequently.
5- Periodically report the market conditions according to the progress and needs of business development, formulate practicable and effective sales strategies and business planning schemes.
jobs.Require:
1- More than 10+ years experience of KA sales of automation and robots industry, familiar with the whole process of sales activities.
2- Fluent in English skills, and other foreign language skills are preferred.
3- Excellent negotiation skills, enormous capacity for business negotiation, good at grasping customers' needs and able to respond timely and accurately.
4- “Drive” to support the achievement of financial sales goals.
5- Good at team work, strong self-motivated and self-learner, good management in the work process and target.

jobs.Duty:
About the Role
The key role and responsibility of this role is to strategize and establish, develop, motivate and manage a quality channel partner network in the assigned region of the U.S. You are overall responsible for the sales target as our sales goes via our channel partner network and ensure we are successful in our Go-to-Market. You are to also manage the MarCom strategy and establish processes necessary to support your development of sales/ market and sales results. 

Responsibilities:
• Achieve sales targets and YoY growth via channel partner network in the assigned region.
• Hunt, develop and maintain a quality network of channel partners comprising of technical distribution- or SI profiles who will scale with us.
• Onboard, activate, motivate and manage channel partners.
• Ability to develop partners to maximize their potential.
• Ability to influence and develop annual partner Dobot strategy and business plans.
• Manage and support channel partner’s pipeline.
• Regular review of business performances of channel partners and to influence and make root cause analysis on poor performances and apply counter measures.
• Manage distribution contract negotiations and signing.
• Conduct sales training to develop, motivate and support our channel partners’ sales team.
• Participate in outreach events i.e exhibitions, road shows, seminars, speaking opportunities.
• Help establish processes necessary in supporting business growth and in achieving targets. 
• Provide market intelligence and carry out sales forecast and reporting.
jobs.Require:
What we look for:
• Excellent interpersonal skills, high standing, and abilities to manage relationship with our customers and our colleagues.
• Min. 10 years of experience in establishing, developing and managing channel partner network in a B-to-B sales environment.
• Proven track record of achieving sales targets via channel partner network.
• Proven track record in penetrating new markets and in growing sales and market share exponentially.
• Preferably from the automation or robotic industries.
• Excellent communicator, good at collaboration across departments/ regions and understand cross-cultural differences.
• Understand and can present value propositions convincingly to customers.
• Work well independently but also a team player.
• Highly motivated, self-directed, and results driven.
• Strong understanding of solution sales business and working with channel partners.
• Ability to operate between “hunting” for new possibilities and “farming” existing customers and finding the required channel of partners to develop the business.
• Think and work at both strategic and hands on level.
• Flexible and professional.
